{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Created wordfreq.mjs and test/wordfreq.test.mjs"}],"files":[{"path":"wordfreq.mjs","content":"#!/usr/bin/env node\n\"use strict\";\nimport { readFile } from 'fs/promises';\n\n/**\n * Compute the top N most frequent words in a text file.\n * @param {string} filePath - Path to the input text file.\n * @param {number} [top=10] - Number of top words to return.\n * @returns {Promise<Array<[string, number]>>} - Array of [word, count] sorted.\n */\nexport async function getTopWords(filePath, top = 10) {\n    const data = await readFile(filePath, 'utf8');\n    // Normalize: lower case, replace non-word chars with space\n    const words = data\n        .toLowerCase()\n        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ') // keep digits? but words are letters\n        .trim()\n        .split(/\\s+/)\n        .filter(Boolean);\n    const freq = new Map();\n    for (const w of words) {\n        freq.set(w, (freq.get(w) ?? 0) + 1);\n    }\n    const sorted = Array.from(freq.entries()).sort((a, b) => {\n        if (b[1] !== a[1]) return b[1] - a[1];\n        return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]);\n    });\n    return sorted.slice(0, top);\n}\n\nasync function main() {\n    const args = process.argv.slice(2);\n    if (args.length === 0) {\n        console.error('Usage: wordfreq <file> [--top N]');\n        process.exit(1);\n    }\n    const filePath = args[0];\n    let top = 10;\n    for (let i = 1; i < args.length; i++) {\n        if (args[i] === '--top' && i + 1 < args.length) {\n            const n = parseInt(args[i + 1], 10);\n            if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n > 0) top = n;\n            i++; // skip value\n        }\n    }\n    try {\n        const result = await getTopWords(filePath, top);\n        for (const [word, count] of result) {\n            console.log(`${word} ${count}`);\n        }\n    } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error:', err.message);\n        process.exit(1);\n    }\n}\n\nif (import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`) {\n    main();\n}\n"},"path":"test/wordfreq.test.mjs","content":"import { strict as assert } from 'assert';\nimport { getTopWords } from '../wordfreq.mjs';\nimport { writeFile, unlink } from 'fs/promises';\nimport path from 'path';\n\nasync function createTempFile(content) {\n    const tmp = path.join(process.cwd(), 'tmp_test_file.txt');\n    await writeFile(tmp, content);\n    return tmp;\n}\n\nasync function removeTempFile(file) {\n    await unlink(file);\n}\n\ndescribe('wordfreq', () => {\n    it('should return top 10 words by default', async () => {\n        const txt = 'Hello world! Hello again. World world.';\n        const file = await createTempFile(txt);\n        try {\n            const res = await getTopWords(file);\n            assert.deepEqual(res, [ ['world', 3], ['hello', 2], ['again', 1] ]);\n        } finally {\n            await removeTempFile(file);\n        }\n    });\n\n    it('should respect --top option', async () => {\n        const txt = 'a b a c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z';\n        const file = await createTempFile(txt);\n        try {\n            const res = await getTopWords(file, 5);\n            assert.deepEqual(res, [ ['a', 2], ['b', 1], ['c', 1], ['d', 1], ['e', 1] ]);\n        } finally {\n            await removeTempFile(file);\n        }\n    });\n});\n"}],"patches":[],"scratchpad":""}
